question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is 'several'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence 'of minor linguistic groups from (5)______ language families unrelated to one another. ' requires an appropriate word from the given options to be filled in the blank.
 
• Let us **understand** the meanings of the **given options:**
 
 
• ​​​​​**Several **means separate or distinct from one another, more than two but fewer than many.
 
• ** Abundant** means existing in very large quantities; more than enough.
 
• ** Quite** means completely; very.
 
• ** Moderate** means kept or keeping within reasonable or proper limits.
 
 
 
• From the **above-given** meanings, the marked option** 'several'** fits well in the given blank as it explains the given context.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 1.**
